<!--- Please add one of the following as a prefix to the pull request title: -->
<!--- DOC: for documentation changes -->
<!--- MAINT: for maintenance changes, e.g., build pipeline fixes -->
<!--- FIX: for bug fixes -->
<!--- TEST: for adding tests -->
<!--- FEAT: for new features and enhancements (including applicable tests and documentation) -->
<!--- If your PR is not yet ready for review, create it as a Draft PR. -->
<!--- If your PR requires users to make a corresponding change (e.g., naming changes), -->
<!--- add [BREAKING] before the title prefix, e.g., [BREAKING] FEAT: ... -->

## Description

<!--- Describe the goal of this PR in 1-2 sentences. It should solve one problem end to end. -->
<!--- Add a concise bulleted list of how you accomplished this goal. -->
<!--- Include a concise demonstration where applicable, e.g., before/after screenshots for UI changes -->
<!--- or before/after scorer outputs (score and rationale) for the same response and scoring criteria. -->
<!--- For breaking changes, explain why the change is necessary and how users should migrate. -->

## Tests and Documentation

<!--- Contributions require tests and documentation where applicable. -->
<!--- Briefly describe tests and documentation added or updated. -->
<!--- List the exact validation commands run and their results. State what was not run and why. -->
<!--- Rerun notebooks affected by code or documentation changes and report the results. -->

<!--- Guidance -->
<!--- Before starting a contribution, open an issue to confirm it fits PyRIT's plans. -->
<!--- Maintainers may identify obstacles or clarify requirements, saving you time. -->
<!--- Mention related issues, pull requests, or discussions with #<issue/PR/discussion ID>. -->
<!--- Tag people for whom this PR may be of interest using @<username>. -->
